    • OrderBooksManager

      public OrderBooksManager(OrderBookSubscribable orderBookSubscribable, int maxSize, int initialCapacity, long expireAfterAccessMinutes)
      Initializes the order book manager with a Guava cache for fast local order book lookups. The cache evicts entries after the specified access timeout and triggers automatic unsubscription via the removal listener. A self-subscribing PublishSubject bridges incoming order book events into the cache for on-demand access.
      Parameters:
      orderBookSubscribable - the source for WebSocket order book subscriptions
      maxSize - maximum number of cached order books
      initialCapacity - initial cache capacity
      expireAfterAccessMinutes - cache expiry time after last access (in minutes)

    • subscribe

      public boolean subscribe(io.reactivex.rxjava3.functions.Consumer<? super org.knowm.xchange.dto.marketdata.OrderBook> onNext, org.knowm.xchange.instrument.Instrument instrument)
      Subscribes to order book updates for a single instrument. Prevents duplicate subscriptions by checking the subscription map first. On success, stores the Disposable for later cleanup. The subscription delegates to the underlying OrderBookSubscribable and optionally applies a custom observable mapper for operators like throttling or sampling.
      Parameters:
      onNext - the consumer to invoke for each order book update
      instrument - the instrument to subscribe to
      Returns:
      true if a new subscription was created, false if already subscribed or unavailable

    • subscribeOrderBook

      protected Optional<io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Observable<org.knowm.xchange.dto.marketdata.OrderBook>> subscribeOrderBook(org.knowm.xchange.instrument.Instrument instrument)
      Creates the underlying order book observable from the WebSocket subscribable source. Pre-populates the cache with an empty entry for the instrument (signals "subscribed but no data yet"). Applies the custom observable mapper if set; otherwise defaults to subscribing on the IO scheduler.
      Parameters:
      instrument - the instrument to subscribe to
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the observable, or empty if the source returned null
